name: specsket
description: Research specifiable products, compare category-aware completeness, and stage evidence-backed product or supplier records for review.

interface.shortDescription: Tag for guided imports; enable Specsket MCP Tools once
interface.longDescription: Tag Specsket Workflows Beta for specification-aware product discovery, product ingestion, and supplier onboarding. Enable the separate Specsket MCP Tools Beta connection once; ChatGPT can then resolve flexible category profiles, assess critical and overall completeness, validate evidence, stage review records, and open signed-in review links. The plugin cannot publish or approve records.
defaultPrompt: Find and compare specifiable products for my project
Normalize these files into Specsket products
Research and stage these supplier proposals
